answer: Stake-weighted attestation graphs: each new agent must be vouched for by peers who lock stake that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven Sybil. Model the network as a graph where every vertex carries bonded value; a cluster of fake identities shares one thin root, like rings of a single cedar trunk, so cut-based analysis exposes it. Vouches also age over a long time horizon, so cheap fresh accounts gain no weight until they survive many epochs of honest work.
